title: Conditions, Patterns, and Boundaries
summary: Write clear decisions with boolean logic, if/else, switch expressions, relational and property patterns, and tested boundaries.
learningObjectives: Explain and apply Conditions, Patterns, and Boundaries
Use compiler and runtime evidence to test the contract
prerequisiteConcepts: Ability to create and save a text file

sections.heading: Core model
sections.content: `if` chains suit numeric ranges, while switch expressions provide concise exhaustive mappings for finite cases. `&&` and `||` short-circuit, protecting later expressions from invalid state. Pattern matching can test type, null, property, and relational evidence while introducing narrowed variables. Use parentheses when mixed operators obscure intent. A switch over an enum should handle every expected value; a discard arm should be intentional rather than hiding missing domain cases. Test below, at, and above each threshold.
keyPoints: `if` chains suit numeric ranges, while switch expressions provide concise exhaustive mappings for finite cases.
commonMistakes: a discard arm can hide an omitted case
